verdict.line: You lose if you feed free autos into a live Blinding Dart while farming at levels 2-3; you win if you survive to 6 and drag him into Realm of Death before he can kite away.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser's Q (675 range) and E (700 range) both reach as far as Teemo's Q and E (680 range), so this isn't a standard melee-vs-ranged poke lane — Morde can trade spell damage at the same distance Teemo pokes from. The real asymmetry is that Teemo's Q (Blinding Dart) shuts down auto-attack trades but does nothing to Q, E, or R, so Morde should fight with spells and save autos for when the blind is down. At level 6, Realm of Death removes Teemo's only real defensive tool — running away — which is why Mordekaiser holds the measured 50.3% win rate over 1,189 games.

theirWindow.when: levels 2-3, you're pushed up for CS
theirWindow.what: Teemo's Q (Blinding Dart, 8s cooldown) and passive Toxic Shot poison punish any auto-attack trade for free since you have no gap closer. Hold Q (Obliterate) for max-range poke on him instead of walking up to last-hit under his threat range.

yourWindow.what: Realm of Death drags him into an isolated 1v1 where Move Quick's kiting stops mattering. Open with E (Death's Grasp) if he's at the edge of its 700 range to guarantee the pull, then R to finish — he has no hard escape once you're both in the realm.

powerCurve.note: Blinding Dart punishes autos, no gap closer yet
E (Death's Grasp) online, Q trades at matching range
Realm of Death isolates him, Rylai's locks down kiting
Riftmaker/Liandry's sustain outlasts his poke entirely

start.why: The passive block and regen directly offset Toxic Shot's on-hit poison and Blinding Dart chip damage while you're forced to walk up for CS early.

boots.why: Magic resist blunts his Q/E poke damage and the tenacity shortens the slow from any Noxious Trap you step on near brush.

core.why: The slow on Q and E stacks with Death's Grasp to make sure he can't walk or Move Quick his way out of your realm once R lands.
Omnivamp sustains you through his poke while you farm for the Realm of Death timing, and ramps damage the longer an isolated fight runs.
Burn damage punishes him for standing in your Q/E zone during the extended 1v1 Realm of Death forces.

situational.when: if you need more healing to outlast poke and keep extending fights
if their team shifts to heavy auto-attack damage after lane
if you need extra gap close since Mordekaiser has no dash

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror's ramping damage and healing rewards the sustained E-pull-into-R combat pattern this matchup is built around, converting extended isolated fights into guaranteed wins.

summoners.why: Ignite secures the kill once Realm of Death isolates him — he has low early HP and no hard escape besides Move Quick, which the realm neutralizes anyway.

playing.title: Trade with spells, not autos
playing.detail: Blinding Dart only disables basic attacks; Q and E deal their damage regardless of blind. Poke at 675-700 range and avoid walking into auto range while his Q is up.

playing.title: Survive levels 2-3 passively
playing.detail: Don't contest every wave — his Q and on-hit poison punish forced trades before your E comes online. Farm with Q at max range instead.

playing.title: Pull overextensions with E
playing.detail: Death's Grasp drags all enemies in its area to you; use it the moment he pushes too far for a last hit to force a free trade.

playing.title: Realm of Death the instant he's isolated
playing.detail: At level 6, use R the moment he pushes or is caught away from minions — this is the matchup's defining kill window per measured data.

playing.title: Bank Indestructible before all-ins
playing.detail: W stores damage dealt and taken into a shield; pre-trade a few hits so you can consume it for healing mid-fight rather than saving it unused.

playing.title: Scout for mushrooms near brush
playing.detail: Noxious Trap has almost no cooldown per charge and slows plus damages over time — check brush edges before diving contested skirmishes.

playing.title: Build toward the pull, not around it
playing.detail: Rylai's slow from Q/E stacks with Death's Grasp so he can't walk out of auto range once pulled, even with Move Quick active.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, win rates, and pick rates are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the trade logic, timings, and combo sequencing are my own read of the ability kit.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being punished during level 2~3 while focusing on farming lane with your skills. After reaching level 6, use [P] to fight Teemo in close quarters to kill him.
